# Outdooractive

> > Europe's largest outdoor platform for discovering, planning, and sharing hiking, cycling, skiing, and mountain adventures with interactive mapping and community features.

Outdooractive is a comprehensive outdoor activity platform serving Europe with route planning tools, real-time conditions, weather data, and accommodation search. It integrates GPS technology, community contributions, and partnerships with major outdoor brands like Garmin, Strava, and Suunto to provide an all-in-one solution for outdoor enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Route Planning
- Interactive Maps
- GPS & GPX
- Hiking Trails
- Mountain Biking
- Skiing & Snow Conditions
- Alps
- Weather Data
- Avalanche Reports
- Trip Planning
- Community Sharing
- Accommodation Search
- Activity Tracking
- Europe
- Outdoor Adventures

## Core Planning Tools

- [Map](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/map): Interactive map with route planning, layers, and trail discovery functionality
- [Route Planner](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/routeplanner): Route planner tool with elevation profiles, waypoints, and GPX import/export
- [Routes](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/routes): Route discovery and finder for hiking, trekking, skiing, and mountain biking

## Destination & Activity Discovery

- [Travel Guide](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/travel-guide): Regional travel guides for European destinations with outdoor activity recommendations
- [Places to Visit](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/places-to-visit): Points of interest and excursion destinations for vacation and activity planning
- [Collections](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/lists): Curated collections and guides for hiking, cycling, skiing, and mountain activities
- [Events](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/events): Event discovery and search for outdoor activities and regional events
- [Offers](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/offers): Bookable outdoor adventures and guided tours for vacation planning

## Conditions & Safety

- [Weather](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/weather): Interactive weather map with forecasts, snow conditions, and precipitation tracking
- [Avalanche Report](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/avalanches): Alpine avalanche reports and winter safety warnings for backcountry skiing
- [Conditions](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/conditions): Current trail conditions, closures, and safety warnings from community and editors
- [Webcams](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/webcams): Live webcams for weather and snow conditions integrated with tour planning

## Specialty Finders

- [Ski Resorts](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/skiresorts): European ski resort finder with daily snow reports and weather information
- [Mountain Huts](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/huts): Alpine hut finder for hiking accommodations and hut-to-hut tours in the Alps
- [Crags](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/climbingspots): Climbing crag finder covering sport, traditional, alpine climbing and bouldering
- [Accommodations](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/accommodations): Accommodation search and lodging options for outdoor vacation planning
- [Eat & Drink](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/eat-and-drink): Restaurant and bar finder integrated with travel guides and trip planning

## Community & Account

- [Community](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/community): Community platform for sharing routes, organizing trips, and connecting outdoor enthusiasts
- [Sign In](https://www.outdooractive.com/en/community/sign-in.html): Login and account creation page for community access and ViewRanger migration

## Home

- [Outdooractive Home](https://www.outdooractive.com/en): Europe's largest outdoor platform for hiking, cycling, biking, skiing with route planner
